response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT ordertune, execution_count, execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), above_average AS (SELECT execution_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(execution_count) AS summed_counts, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM above_average WHERE share > overall_average_share;

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the unweighted arithmetic mean across order-type groups, including a NULL ordertune group if present; the primary query uses PostgreSQL syntax and returns NULL aggregates if no group exceeds that mean.
